text:
ana: Quick async check-in for my shift — SLO/alert follow-ups and a couple ops asks

ana: Yesterday: rolled the small batcher backpressure fix to prod; 99p latency improved and 503s dropped from ~0.7% -> ~0.2% after the rollback patch.

ana: Blocker: seeing intermittent kv-cache evictions when host memory > ~78%. Eviction pattern lines up with a warmup spike from a quantized model variant (suspected leakage in our warmup routine). No clear RCA yet.

ana: Today: 1) pair with liam at 10:30 to repro and capture heap/profile, 2) add temporary padding to kv-cache config if we see another spike, 3) review PRs for alert debounce changes.

ravi: can you drop the prom query you used to spot the evictions? want to add the check to our synthetic alert dashboard.

ana: sure — pasted query below (quick snippet):

```promql
sum(rate(kv_cache_evictions_total[5m])) by (instance)
/
sum(rate(kv_cache_ops_total[5m])) by (instance)
```

ana: filter by job="inference-runtime" and look for spikes > 0.01 for 5m windows.

liam: I'll join. I earlier removed an aggressive idle GC flag which temporarily lowered OOMs but there were tiny regressions in resident memory; might be related. I'll bring heap dump tooling.

maya: saw two pgs overnight where fallback to the smaller model kicked in and user latency stayed within SLO because of the routing fallback — that worked as intended. Suggest we wire a canary for the quantized variant so warmup #s are visible before routing picks it up.

oncall-bot: Incident #2026 auto-closed at 07:52 — root cause: transient mem pressure on inference-host-07, mitigated by autoscaler. (reaction :white_check_mark:)

ravi: quick ask — PR 432 (batcher: debounce tweak + metrics) is ready for review: https://git.company/pr/432. Can someone skim? low-risk but we should get it before EOD.

ana: I can review after pairing with liam (ETA 11:45).

maya: I'll take ownership of the debounce rollout — propose changing silence window from 120s -> 180s for 5xx batcher alerts and add a metric-level guard to only silence if rate < 0.5% for 3m.

liam: +1 to the guard, +1 to the longer window. :thumbsup:

ravi: noted, I'll queue the dashboard update and add the prom query as a panel in the oncall view.

ana: TL;DR: patch landed yesterday helped latency; current blocker = kv-cache evictions tied to quantized warmup; pairing at 10:30 to gather heap/profile; maya will drive debounce rollout; ravi adding dashboard check. Anyone else with blockers?

liam: none from me, will post any artifacts after the pairing.

maya: none, will create a short rollout playbook for the debounce change and tag oncall.

ana: thanks — tag me if you see another eviction spike. :eyes:
